title: The silent-undo scan refuses a one-sentence in-place rewrite of a line as a dropped line, so an honest edit needs a Drops-lines trailer and a new head
why: Sighting 06:33 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:32, relayed from runner 11; the coordinator did not read the guard record, and triage has not; unproven): degen #706, `merge 706 --confirm` refused by the silent-undo scan at merge 3208dcca7. The scan reads a one-sentence in-place rewrite of the merge-grant line in the degen project instructions (CLAUDE.md) as a dropped line. Runner 11's read: the diff against main is only the intended sentence. The printed remedy is a commit with the trailer `Drops-lines: CLAUDE.md -- <reason>`; lane child-ci-degen pushes it, which costs a new head (CI, fix check, record). Degen #706 stays held until that head's run is green; #704 and #710 wait for it. Why it matters: the root rule says to rewrite superseded text in place, so a scan that counts every in-place rewrite as a drop refuses honest edits; rate unknown (unmeasured). Related and not the same: step silent-undo-appended-negation (every original token survives, only a negation is appended; ready) and silent-undo-restored-line (done). First act of the lane: read the guard record and the scan, reproduce on the #706 diff, red then green, with a control that a real dropped line is still refused. A check change, so review round 3 applies. COORDINATOR 06:35 CST Nov 14 (06:33, relayed): queued, no lane yet. #706 takes the Drops-lines trailer route; the step is not on the merge path; a check change touching lint competes with the merge.py queue (#3377 first). The coordinator starts it after #3377 lands. COST SAMPLE 06:37 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:35, relayed from runner 11; unread by triage): degen #706's Drops-lines trailer failed twice (lane commits 319f31a07 and e8869badb): the trailer line sat in its own paragraph above Co-Authored-By, so git reads no trailer. A third commit is coming. Each costs a CI run; CI on e8869badb is running for a head that will be replaced (n=1). The lane of this step should also test the trailer-paragraph pitfall (a trailer must sit in the last paragraph). The first reason asked for ("no meaning dropped") was wrong: the reworded clause narrows degen's pending-record sentence to unproven pushes, so the reason says that. That narrowing is a rule text change in degen's project instructions that the owner was not asked about. Triage asked runner 11 for the before and after sentence; no owner item until it is read. SECOND READ 06:42 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:37, its own REST read of degen pulls/706/files; agrees with runner 11 word for word): the only changed line is the last sentence of the merge-grant bullet, and the edit APPENDS a qualifier clause after the original words; the original words stay, in order. So the refused edit keeps every original token in order and adds words, the same shape as step silent-undo-appended-negation (ready). The lane may fold the two: one fix, "the rewrite excuse holds when every original token survives in order", with a control that a real dropped line is still refused. Not yet read at the scan code. LANE STARTED 06:51 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:48, relayed): lane silent-undo-trailer-and-rewrite (session_013NEJL1sQdYhZzBrVywMEdX, Sonnet medium, tracker the coordinator, path ALONE, draft first, branch slug silent-undo-trailer-rewrite, created 12:46Z) takes steps silent-undo-inplace-rewrite and silent-undo-remedy-shows-trailer: one scan. First act: read the guard record and reproduce on the #706 diff, red then green, with a real-drop control. The brief does not say round 3 applies; the merge tool decides (owner item 833 open). CORRECTION 07:30 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 07:30, from runner 11; unread by triage): the scan took the FIRST Drops-lines trailer per path, so on degen #706 it read the old reason ("one sentence, no meaning dropped", commit 01d375cd0); a later reason in the PR body would not have overridden it. The earlier claim that it would was runner 11's read of `allowed`, passed on by the coordinator, and was wrong; moot now (#706 merged, main d37b88bd47d0). The true reason sits only in commit 1fe4944a9. Add to the lane: the scan takes the first trailer per path, so a remedy printed once must be right the first time; test that a second trailer for the same path does not override the first, or change it to read the last (the lane reads the code first). Owner look: the narrowed sentence is now in degen main; triage decided no owner item (ruling push-skip-proven-tree covers it); the coordinator asked that this be named. LANE HAND-IN 07:48 CST Nov 14 (lane silent-undo-trailer-rewrite, 07:47, as data; triage read neither PR nor code): PR #3401, head c1da982d76, handed off. Lane read allowed() by running it: with several commits carrying a Drops-lines line for one path, the scan keeps the OLDEST commit's reason (git log newest first, each line overwrites); a PR-body line beats all commits only where the merge tool passes the body. So a wrong first reason sticks, as on degen #706 (this corrects the earlier "first trailer" wording only in method: same result, the oldest). The lane took option A, its own reversible pick: keep oldest-wins, print a warning in the remedy, and add tests that pin it; no change to the check's verdict. Its question to the coordinator and to triage is withdrawn; no owner item. Option B (read the newest; gain: a later commit corrects a wrong reason; lose: a later reason can silently replace an honest one, and it is a check change, so another review round) stays open as a later step if wanted: not filed. Not reported by the lane: whether #3401 also stops the scan refusing an in-place rewrite that keeps the original words (the step silent-undo-inplace-rewrite); read the PR before closing that step.
